2: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Deliver me, Lord, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man;
3: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
4: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper's poison is under their lips. Selah.
5: Lord, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
6: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
7: I said to the Lord, "You are my God." Listen to the cry of my petitions, Lord.
8: Lord, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
9: Lord, do not grant the desires of the wicked. Do not let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
10: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
11: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
12: An evil speaker won't be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
13: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
14: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
